action.objective: Consolidate the center by recapturing on d4 with the e3 pawn, opening the e2 bishop's diagonal and preparing to castle.
action.rationale: exd4 is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 3 with exact score 88, safety complete (no mate-in-one). It regains the pawn, frees the e2 bishop and keeps kingside castling available, unlike the b3d4 knight recapture (score 80, recent-move penalty). No comparison table exists, so I retain the deeper 88 evidence and commit the fully verified move.
